summary: WI-1001 implementation is approved: loom CLI release evidence now has a root VERSION plus GitHub v* release line, node-installer release judgment is limited to installer shim/package changes, and release surface checks enforce that installer latest/tags are not used as CLI publish evidence.

No publish was performed. Current external evidence shows `@mc-and-his-agents/loom-installer` npm `latest` is `0.1.119`, latest installer GitHub Release is `loom-installer-v0.1.119`, and existing Loom CLI GitHub Release is `v0.12.0`; this work item defines the split and expects PR/main workflow judgment before any explicit `workflow_dispatch` publish.
